purpose: Supervised dynamic endpoint capability, not mission benefit or an aircraft waiting policy
training_trigger: Any of three fixed development 50-step/64-frame forecasts has wrong/unknown state or RGB MAE above 12; never use held-out outcomes to trigger or tune training
learning_scope: Existing final block and output/attention heads only; base, VAE and time embedding frozen
loss: Upstream diffusion loss plus 4x latent epsilon MSE inside prior development-only motion mask
time_contract: All training uses actual 4 Hz acquisition offsets /128; offsets 1,16,64 mean .25,4,16 seconds
ablation: Same training observation: 50/250 sampling steps crossed with frame offset 1/64; no checkpoint selection on test data
evaluation: Four newly recorded timing cases plus four previously inspected regression cases, before and after one serialized adapter update
adoption: No flight or mission adoption even if endpoint gate passes; interval occupancy and both-action validation remain required
comparison: Current image persistence and before/after native weights. Ideal Rules superiority not required
